notes: State Cliopatria lacks (no row). Twenty-three of the twenty-five member states are not named on any page opened (Madhya Bharat, Central India Agency, History of Madhya Pradesh, Gwalior State, Indore State); the Malwa-region approximation stands for them, so the shape is 1.24 times the page's area. A gap-filler should open a list of princely states of the Central India Agency (the Malwa and Bhopawar agencies) to name them and to draw Dhar, Dewas, Ratlam and the rest. The pages give the creation date as 28 May 1948 but the members' own dates differ (Gwalior accession 15 June 1948, Indore 16 June 1948 per the indore-state dossier, Madhya Bharat's instrument 13 September 1948); the dossier dates all gains to May. No winter and summer capital is on the pages opened, although Gwalior and Indore are the two cities of the union. The land is inside the Dominion of India (Cliopatria 'Republic of India' from 1947); the renderer should let this union take precedence. No wars.
